model.source: market_uncertainty_v1 sv_prototype Target, P=1 intercept, K=0 flow
model.data: simulated, simulate.py seed 84084 (real receipts not reused: no reuse licence recorded)

quantities.h_next: mu + rho (h_last - mu) + exp(log_sigma) eps, eps[c,j] = default_rng(840000+tick).normal(size=(4,20000))[c,j]
quantities.quote: straddle proportional to E[exp(h_next/2)], Rao-Blackwellised exp(m/2+sigma^2/8); reported, not gated

validity.primary: |q_arm - q_ref| <= 3 mcse_ref for all three quantiles AND max rank R-hat(mu,log_sigma,h_last,h_next) <= 1.01 AND 0 divergences (retained)
validity.secondary_reported_only: |q_arm - q_ref| <= 3 sqrt(mcse_ref^2 + mcse_arm^2), same R-hat/divergence conditions
validity.chain_warnings: recorded for ref/refit; n/a for warm (four single-chain runs)

arms.warm: tick-0 default fit 4x1000/1000 (not in latency stats, reported); then K in {50,200} transitions/chain/tick, Adaptation::None, warmup 0, step and diagonal metric frozen from tick 0, new z appended at 0 with mass 1
arms.cmdstan: CmdStan 2.39.0 defaults via cmdstanpy 1.3.0, 4 parallel chains

latency: wall per tick from new-target construction to draws in memory (Stan arms: data update + sample call incl. process/CSV); quantile computation excluded

drift.statistic: per tick fraction of warm h_next draws inside reference [P5,P95]
drift.bound: |mean over ticks 1-100 - 0.90| <= 0.03 AND |mean(76-100) - mean(1-25)| <= 0.03, per seed
drift.secondary: coverage of true h[N+t] by the arm's 90% interval over 100 ticks (reported)

decision_rule: README may say 'real-time' only if for some K the warm arm is (primary-valid AND under 0.4 s) on >= 95% of the 300 ticks at N=250 AND (primary-valid AND under 2 s) on >= 95% at N=1000, and drift is within bound on all 3 seeds at both N. Otherwise the README states measured latency and validity only.

predictions.P1: warm K=50 median latency 5-60 ms at N=250, 20-250 ms at N=1000; K=200 4x that
predictions.P2: refit oWALNUTS median 0.3-2 s at N=250, 1-8 s at N=1000
predictions.P3: CmdStan median 0.4-3 s at N=250, 1.5-10 s at N=1000; nutpie 0.3-2 s / 1-8 s
predictions.P4: primary validity <= 40% for every arm (an arm's own MC error is 2-20x the reference MCSE), so the real-time rule FAILS
predictions.P5: secondary validity >= 80% for refit arms, >= 60% for warm K=200, >= 40% warm K=50
predictions.P6: warm drift within bound on >= 5/6 (N, seed) for K=200

basis_for_predictions: WP78 per-gradient walls (Rust 1.6 us at d=100) scaled to about 5 us (N=250) and 20 us (N=1000) per SV gradient, about 30-80 gradients per transition
execution: lane 4 (cores 12-15) of the shared c7a.4xlarge, taskset-pinned, co-tenanted with three other lanes: walls are 'pinned, co-tenanted'; validity unaffected
discipline: cells sequential in this order; a started cell is never rerun; failures are results
